verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Mistral's Document AI solution page. It positions the product for "compliance-first organizations requiring secure on-premises deployment" and says Mistral sells self-hosted/on-prem enterprise deployments alongside its hosted platform. All the technical docs describe the hosted API only, so the self-hosted option appears to be a marketing-level, sales-gated enterprise offering with no documented procedure. Missing for 10: technical docs for self-hosted or VPC deployment of the OCR/annotation stack (containers, hardware requirements, air-gapped operation), confirmation that every feature works on-prem, explicit VPC/private-cloud deployment options, and independent or hands-on reports of running it self-hosted.
